About the job

Nordlicht Bank's Sofia hub builds the bank's online and mobile banking. Our application security team works with forty product teams to keep that software safe.

Your role

  • Threat-model new features with product teams
  • Run and tune SAST and DAST in our pipelines
  • Review Java and Kotlin code for security issues

Your profile

  • 3+ years in application security
  • Good knowledge of the OWASP Top 10
  • OSCP or a similar certificate is a plus
  • Fluent English

Hybrid: two days a week in our Sofia office.
